mission: Mission-08 Phase A (addendum Q7 runtime guard)
finding: Frozen P2P Preservation Rule V1's POST-STABILITY cap makes raw candidate-node execution computationally infeasible at the DEV 47-task scale (corrected discovery: 230,181 raw nodes).
discovery_correction_note: Revision 1 contained a discovery-mechanism bug (inline mapfile through bash -lc silently read 0 lines for 43/47 tasks -> whole-suite node sets; cassette []-path args made pytest error; __init__.py args caused package-leak of changed files). Fixed by: (a) script-file execution, (b) .py-only collect args, (c) excluding __init__.py/conftest.py + []-paths. Final discovery validated: 0/47 subset violations, deterministic re-run identical.

execution_condition.parent: parent commit + SAME frozen test patch as Linux V2 F2P oracle (TEST_PATCH_APPLIED_ON_PARENT=true)
execution_condition.cap: fixed-seed 400 applied to STABLE_P2P set only, AFTER stability execution

inventory.zero_node_reason: webhook/observability/tests/conftest.py imports fakeredis, absent from the FROZEN py39 era deps (environment-collection limitation; unchanged-test discovery yields 0 nodes; deterministic)

storage.maintenance_note: wall-time bound; ~12-day serial run needs checkpointing/resume (C4 precedent)

perf_gate.reason: addendum runtime guard forbids large-task P2P execution; minimum valid gate requires a bounded gate set whose largest member is computationally infeasible under frozen V1 semantics; perf-gate worker scaling cannot fix frozen-semantics infeasibility
perf_gate.conclusion: Do NOT run perf gate under frozen V1 semantics

decision.phase_a_execution: STOPPED before LARGE pilot and before full 47-task P2P
decision.requires: scientifically defensible P2P V2 scaling amendment (see options)
decision.no_precap: no pre-stability cap or raw-node sampling was introduced

amendment_options.title: Two-stage preservation oracle
amendment_options.description: Run ALL raw nodes once at target and once at parent (2x, not 3x3); apply cap=400 deterministically to the raw discovered set BEFORE execution; classify only the capped 400 nodes 3/3+3/3. Requires amending the frozen V1 repetition/cap semantics.

amendment_options.title: Stratified node cap at discovery
amendment_options.description: Deterministic fixed-seed cap applied to discovered nodes per top-level app/file stratum, then full 3x3 on the capped set. Changes the preservation population definition.

amendment_options.title: Task-subsampled preservation
amendment_options.description: Preserve frozen V1 semantics but evaluate preservation on a small deterministic task subsample (e.g. ENG 9) and report as pilot-only preservation evidence, not full-population.

amendment_options.title: Single-shot + stability spot-check
amendment_options.description: Run each raw node 1x per state for all nodes (fast screening), then 3x3 only on nodes that passed 1x1 and on a deterministic spot-check sample. Explicitly amends repetition semantics.
